title: Production Question Pool
principles: candidate pools are separated from reserve pools

sourcePolicy.RIASEC: 60 V2 production items + 12 sample reserve items
sourcePolicy.DISC: 24 V2 production items expanded with sample items to 80 production + 16 reserve
sourcePolicy.EQ: 24 V2 production items expanded with sample items to 50 production + 10 reserve
sourcePolicy.COGNITIVE: 24 V2 production items expanded where source permits; six required abstract-reasoning items for target/reserve expansion are unavailable in supplied source set

blockers: EQ: source set yields only 29 unique eligible content items (24 V2 + 5 unique sample texts), below 50 production + 10 reserve.

EQ: current Question Bank CSV importer expects EQ scoringKey length 1 plus correctOption, while the V2 EQ production bank uses a 4-value scoringKey and no correctOption. This scoring-contract mismatch must be resolved in V13.7; no scoring metadata is fabricated in V13.5.

Cognitive: unique eligible content supports only 33 target-shaped production items (10 Verbal, 10 Numerical, 7 Logical, 6 Abstract) and 3 reserve items. Additional unique content is required, especially Logical and Abstract Reasoning.
No duplicated text, unrelated legacy content, or construct reclassification is used to pad quantities.
